dz: 伦巴底革命:希腊巴利公民起而反抗由梅卢斯所领导的伦巴底叛军,将这座城市交给了意大利卡特帕纳地的拜占庭总督(catepan)巴西尔·梅萨尔多尼特斯.
de: Lombard Revolt: Greek citizens of Bari rise up against the Lombard rebels led by Melus and deliver the city to Basil Mesardonites, Byzantine governor (catepan) of the Catepanate of Italy.

t: 丹斯在被围攻后俘虏了坎特伯雷,以坎特伯雷大主教的lfheah为囚犯.
te: Danes capture Canterbury after a siege, taking Ælfheah, archbishop of Canterbury, as a prisoner.
